name: Nebraska Prep Equipment
old_description: Nebraska Prep Equipment was founded by Cory Hart and Jamison Wallman in late 2017. While building their last catering kitchen for their then 5-year-old catering business, they were faced with the task of sourcing quality used equipment to stay within budget. Cory and Jamison found that quality used equipment was few and far between locally, so they broadened their search area and found a great amount of quality used equipment in the larger cities throughout the Midwest. Instead of keeping this treasure hidden, Jamison and Cory decided to start transporting this equipment back to Southeast Nebraska, cleaning the equipment and reselling it at a fair price to other food service companies in the area. about:
Nebraska Prep Equipment is based in Adams, Nebraska. The company was founded in late 2017 by Cory Hart and Jamison Wallman. The pair had operated a catering business for five years and, while building a new kitchen, struggled to find quality used equipment locally. They began traveling to larger Midwestern cities to source reliable used pieces, transporting them back to southeast Nebraska, cleaning them, and reselling them to other food‑service operators in the area.

Today the business operates as a food‑service equipment dealer with a showroom on South 82nd Road in Adams. It sells both refurbished used equipment and new units backed by manufacturer warranties, along with occasional scratch‑and‑dent items at reduced prices. The showroom is open by appointment only, and the company emphasizes personal service throughout the buying process.

The customer base consists of locally owned restaurants, caterers, and hospitality businesses throughout the region. The founders’ original catering peers were among the first buyers, and the company continues to focus on independent food‑service operators rather than large chains.

Hart and Wallman started the venture because quality used equipment was scarce in their area. They differentiate themselves by combining a curated selection of used and new brands with what they describe as unparalleled customer service during and after the sale.
